pages.title: End Goal
pages.text: Your final task will be to construct the $(item)Black Hole Containment Vessel$().$(br2)When we finally acquire it our empire will thrive.

pages.title: End Goal
pages.text: Oh thats right, your motivation? Give us the vessel and we will send you the item that will allow you to leave the simulation.$(br2)We assume that by now you yearn to get your feet planted in reality.$(br2)So make a final push, you resourceful caveman!

pages.title: End Goal
pages.text: As you might have noticed, there is a block at the back of the upper platform called the $(item)Nanobot Assembling Unit NAU-02$().$(br2)You will need to make another nanobot kit to create the exit portal.
